routes.name: Indefinite Leave to Remain in the Isle of Man as a Worker Migrant

note: Isle of Man, read on the Isle of Man Government's immigration pages (gov.im: Workers, and Visa application forms and fees) on 2026-10-30. The Island grants its own leave under its own Immigration Rules (new Worker Migrant rules from 1 June 2026). The Tier 5 - Temporary Workers route is for temporary workers whose entry serves cultural, charitable, religious or international objectives, the creative worker's route on a Tier 5 sponsor's certificate (work for the sponsor); where it is applied for isn't stated on the page ('either'). The Worker Migrant route is for employment that can't be filled by a settled worker, on the employer's Confirmation of Employment (no change of employer in the first 12 months), applied for online from the country of residence, the British Embassy referring it to the Island's Immigration Service, and renewed on the Island (form FLR W; either); its fees are on the forms, not read. Indefinite leave to remain as a Worker Migrant (SET W) costs £3,226, applied for on the Island; the years it asks aren't on the pages read, so none are kept. Anyone not an Isle of Man worker also needs a work permit from the Department for Enterprise unless they hold an immigration employment document (leave to enter or remain), which these routes give. British and Irish citizens' Common Travel Area position isn't on the pages read and isn't kept; the EU Settlement Scheme is for those resident before 2021.

sources.title: Isle of Man Government, Workers
sources.said: The Worker Migrant route enables non-British and non-Irish nationals to come to the Isle of Man in order to undertake an employment position which cannot be filled by a Settled Worker. ... The Tier 5 - Temporary Workers route is for certain types of temporary workers whose entry helps to satisfy cultural, charitable, religious or international objectives, including volunteering and job shadowing. ... Applicants living overseas who wish to come to the Isle of Man to work and who hold a valid Confirmation of Employment, must apply online from their country of residence . ... Applicants living in the Isle of Man who wish to renew their worker migrant or worker ICT migrant visa and who hold a valid Confirmation of Employment, should apply to the Isle of Man Immigration Service using form FLR W . ... to prevent a change in employment during the first 12 months of their leave being issued ... A holder of an Immigration Employment Document (IED) is exempt from the requirement for a work permit.
